li.t-attf-class: breadcrumb-item #{'active ' if not (team and team_id_param) else ''}

a.t-attf-href: /my/player?player_id={{ record.id }}{{ (ctx_team and ctx_team.exists()) and ('&team_id=%s' % ctx_team.id) or '' }}
/my/player/activities?player_id={{ record.id }}{{ (ctx_team and ctx_team.exists()) and ('&team_id=%s' % ctx_team.id) or '' }}
/my/player?player_id={{ ctx_patient.id }}{{ (ctx_team and ctx_team.exists()) and ('&team_id=%s' % ctx_team.id) or '' }}

t.t-value: (is_team_view and team and ('/my/player?player_id=' + str(player.id) + '&team_id=' + str(team.id))) or ('/my/player?player_id=' + str(player.id))

div.t-attf-class: card position-relative h-100 shadow-sm {{ 'border-danger' if stage == 'no_play' else 'border-warning' if stage and stage != 'healthy' else '' }}

div.class: d-none d-md-flex align-items-center justify-content-end flex-wrap gap-2

div.t-attf-class: alert alert-{{ notif.get('type', 'info') }} alert-dismissible fade show

div.span: Removal request has been submitted for review.
Player has been successfully removed from the team.

textarea.name: reason
textarea.placeholder: Explain why this player should be added

t.t-if: any(p.pending_removal for p in players) and user_has_group('bemade_sports_clinic.group_portal_treatment_professional')

div.div:
Pending Removals: There are
player(s) with pending removal requests. Review now

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if organization_id and organization_id == org.id else None
'selected' if match_status and match_status == opt[0] else None
'selected' if practice_status and practice_status == opt[0] else None

a.t-att-href: team_context_id and ('/my/activity/create?model=sports.patient&res_id=%s&team_id=%s&return_url=/my/player?player_id=%s&team_id=%s' % (player.id, team_context_id, player.id, team_context_id)) or ('/my/activity/create?model=sports.patient&res_id=%s&return_url=/my/player?player_id=%s' % (player.id, player.id))

div.p: Are you sure you want to remove from this team?

textarea.name: reason
textarea.placeholder: Explain why this player should be removed

div.class: row row-cols-1 row-cols-md-2 row-cols-xl-3 g-3 portal-injury-cards

button.onclick: return confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this contact?');
